interpretation: 30 seconds limits each independently issued authorization lease, not total assistant-turn latency. Old proof/lease deadlines remain immutable.

turn_bounds.accepted_at: server monotonic timestamp at actual initial authorization
turn_bounds.original_jwt_expiry: retain original admitted JWT absolute expiry and its monotonic deadline; later JWT cannot increase it
turn_bounds.run_deadline: min(original JWT deadline, accepted_at + 600 seconds, any stricter original backend/task deadline)
turn_bounds.ownership: same verified principal, opaque conversation and current server-owned runtime turn; no browser caller IDs as authority

continuation.freshness: each protected HTTP heartbeat passes fresh JWT claims/signature and actual verified cloudflared ingress/current core custody, same-origin CSRF and one-use server nonce for this turn; request-start witness <=5 seconds
continuation.issuance: only while current lease, turn and original JWT/run deadlines remain live, issue a distinct new <=30-second lease from that fresh observation, bounded by original turn deadlines; never mutate/restamp or revive old proof
continuation.stream: every byte/input requires independent live lease and <=5-second fresh ingress witness; SSE segments <=4 seconds and reconnect/replay remains owned
continuation.watchdog: loss/refusal/expiry of required witness denies bytes and stops/cancels the exact owned turn within <=5-second freshness bound; no JWT or native proof cache can renew authorization
continuation.later_jwt: must match principal and policy; effective deadline is min(later valid JWT deadline, retained original JWT deadline, fixed run deadline)

evidence.basis: v265 authentication explicitly names <=30s leases; v263 permits fresh protected HTTP renewal but forbids expired-lease revival and bounds by original JWT expiry
required_Pi: actual turn exceeds30 seconds with repeated genuinely fresh heartbeats and succeeds before original deadlines
heartbeat absence/refusal, stale nonce or wrong principal denies and cancels by freshness bound
original JWT expiry and600-second/stricter run deadline terminate despite fresh later JWT
expired lease cannot resume/revive old run; fresh authorized turn required
no restamped request-start or cached ingress proof authorizes continuation

status: implementation and actual Pi proof OPEN; no stable/parity claim
